repository.name: jobFynder-BE-nestJS
repository.description: This is for BE rewamp to nestJS from nodeJS

commits.message:
Add Integration Studio (CORE-600) foundation: connector framework, CEIPAL connector, encrypted credential storage

Introduces the business-system-integrations module per the Integration
Studio architecture doc: a connector registry that fails closed on any
connector missing a deterministic entity_match_key, a generic REST/webhook
reference connector, a CEIPAL connector (structurally complete, not yet
verified against a live account), AES-256-GCM credential storage, and the
connect/sync-config/health/automations API surface.

Tenant scoping is ownerId (User), not Organization — reconciliation found
no staffing-agency OrgType exists yet; recorded as an open item rather than
forcing an unrelated schema decision.

Docs are generated, not hand-maintained: scripts/generate-integration-studio-docs.ts
rebuilds the connector reference table from the live registry, and CI
(.github/workflows/integration-studio-docs-check.yml) fails the build if a
connector change wasn't accompanied by a doc regeneration.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add Oorwin, Bullhorn, JobDiva, Avionté connectors; split Custom API/Webhook

Exercises the Build Plan's Phase 6 gate four times over: each ATS
connector was added as a plugin with zero changes to connector.types.ts
or connector-registry.service.ts, which is the actual evidence the
framework is generic rather than CEIPAL-shaped underneath.

Splits the former generic-rest.connector.ts into two connectors with
genuinely different shapes: custom-api.connector.ts (outbound polling)
and webhook.connector.ts (inbound-only, testConnection just checks a
signing secret is present since there's nothing to call).

Documents, in CORE-600-integration-studio.md §8, exactly why
Communication/Email (Teams, Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram, M365, Gmail)
aren't buildable from this workspace: COMM-1's source isn't code-present
here, and Core has no outbound client or base URL configured to reach
the remote Hermes /providers API that could otherwise surface their
status. Recorded as a real blocker, not papered over.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add read-only COMM-1 communication status bridge (Telegram, verified live)

Adds GET /integration-studio/communication-status, backed by
comm-gateway-client.service.ts, which calls COMM-1's real, deployed
comm-gateway (comm.jobfynder.com) directly. Deliberately not a
ConnectorPlugin: COMM-1 owns Telegram's credentials, Core does not, and
there is no Connect/Configure action for it here - read-only status only.

This corrects an earlier documented assumption. Reading main.py directly
from the running comm-gateway container showed the real route table:
Telegram and Microsoft 365 mail (inbound-only) are live; Slack, Teams,
WhatsApp, and Gmail don't exist in COMM-1's code at all, contradicting
hermes-complete-developer-guide.md's claim that /providers/{provider}
supports them. CORE-600-integration-studio.md section 8 is rewritten
with the verified finding in place of the earlier assumption.

GET /providers/telegram/status was confirmed unauthenticated (read
directly from source, then verified live via curl) - no shared secret
is stored or sent by this client.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add sync execution and rate limiting, closing two named gaps honestly

sync-runner.service.ts pulls data via ConnectorPlugin.fetchObjects() and
writes it through Core's existing single validated path
(JobsService.createJobFromParsed - the same one Hermes's own email-parsed
jobs already use, not a second write path). Deliberately scoped:

- fetchObjects() is implemented for CustomApiConnector only, since that
  is Jobfynder's own generic contract, not a guess at a vendor's
  undocumented API. The five ATS connectors do not implement it -
  writing real list/export calls for CEIPAL/Oorwin/Bullhorn/JobDiva/
  Avionte without a live account to verify against would repeat exactly
  what this module has avoided everywhere else. A connector without
  fetchObjects() is skipped and reported, not silently no-op'd.
- Object mapping into Core exists for Jobs only. Candidates/Submissions
  are fetched and idempotently deduplicated (IntegrationHealthLog claim-
  then-process, proven by a test that runs the same connection twice)
  but not yet mapped into Core rows.

rate-limiter.service.ts: a per-connection fixed-window counter, closing
the other gap named in CORE-600-integration-studio.md Sec9. Deliberately
simple, not a token bucket with a vendor-verified limit - none of the
five ATS connectors' real rate limits were confirmed live.

Adds a "Sync now" action in the Health tab (POST /connectors/:id/sync).

14/14 tests pass across the module; docs Sec2/Sec7/Sec9 updated to match
exactly what's built versus still deliberately unimplemented.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add n8n auth guard and machine-facing API surface

n8n is real and already running (n8n.jobfynder.com / connect.jobfynder.com,
confirmed via docker-compose.yml on the live server) but had no way to
call into Core: every /integration-studio/* endpoint required a human
JWT session. n8n isn't a user, so it gets its own controller instead of
a workaround bolted onto the human-facing one.

- N8nAuthGuard: shared-secret bearer token (N8N_SERVICE_TOKEN),
  constant-time comparison via crypto.timingSafeEqual. Deliberately a
  separate secret from HERMES_SERVICE_TOKEN - different trust boundary,
  one compromised token shouldn't grant the other's access.
- N8nIntegrationController: GET .../n8n/connections/:id/automations and
  POST .../n8n/connections/:id/sync, addressed directly by connectionId
  since there's no ownerId to derive from a session. Both call the exact
  same service methods (sync-runner.service.ts) the human-facing
  endpoints use - one execution path, not two.

Does not close the full loop: Core firing a webhook to n8n when a sync
creates a Job (so n8n can run an automation's THEN step) isn't built,
and that step still depends on COMM-1's outbound notify endpoint, which
also doesn't exist yet. Documented honestly in
CORE-600-integration-studio.md Sec7a rather than implied as done.

19/19 tests pass across the module.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add Core -> n8n webhook trigger, closing the loop with a live workflow

n8n-webhook-notifier.service.ts fires (fire-and-forget) after
sync-runner.service.ts creates a Job, so an n8n workflow's WHEN step
triggers on a real event instead of polling. A webhook delivery failure
never affects the sync itself - it has already committed by then.

This was verified against the real, live n8n instance, not just built
and assumed: imported and published an actual workflow (Integration
Studio - CEIPAL Job to Teams Notify) via n8n's own CLI, restarted the
container (confirmed first that only 4 workflows are active in
production and got explicit go-ahead before restarting), and confirmed
via curl that the webhook responds 200 and starts real execution.

Corrects a real finding: the live n8n domain is connect.jobfynder.com,
not n8n.jobfynder.com - that came from a stale, unused docker-compose.yml
at /opt/n8n/ that doesn't match what's actually running
(/docker/n8n/docker-compose.yml). Documented in
CORE-600-integration-studio.md Sec7a so nobody trusts the stale copy again.

The workflow's WHEN and DO(sync) steps are real; the THEN step (HTTP
Request to COMM-1's /notify/teams) is wired but will 404 until that
endpoint exists - same "structurally complete, not live-verified"
pattern used throughout this module, not silently implied as finished.

The webhook path is itself the access-control secret and is
deliberately not written into .env.example or any committed file, same
discipline held for the CORE database password and
HERMES_COMM_SHARED_SECRET earlier this session.

27/27 tests pass across the module (23 existing + 4 new for the notifier).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add activity module schema: task.isEvolving, notify_rules, notification_outbox

Foundation for docs/jobfynder-activity-module-spec-v1.2.md and
docs/jobfynder-dittofeed-integration-spec-v1.0.md, adapted to this
codebase's Prisma/NestJS conventions (task/relationship_event, no new
activity_events table). Includes the full notify_rules event catalog
seed and rule_configs seeds for the auto-rules built alongside this.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Wire Dittofeed dispatch and the in-app Centrifugo webhook receiver

Core dispatches to Dittofeed directly (no n8n — see
skills/activity-module-notes.md for the reasoning): NotifyDispatchService
is the single "check notify_rules, write outbox" primitive shared by
task-shaped rules and raw events; DittofeedDispatchService drains
notification_outbox and calls Dittofeed's public batch API, mirroring
MessengerOutboxService's proven claim/retry pattern.

DittofeedWebhookController is Job 3's in-app glue code: Dittofeed calls it,
it verifies a shared secret (DittofeedWebhookAuthGuard, same shape as
N8nAuthGuard), and publishes to the recipient's existing user:{userId}
Centrifugo channel. CentrifugoPublisher extracted into its own
CentrifugoModule to avoid a circular import between MessengerModule and
NotificationsModule.

DittofeedDispatchService.diagnostics() plugged into the existing /health
endpoint alongside messengerRealtime, for Job 4 monitoring.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add reply_to_unanswered/profile_completion/reconnect_dormant_contact rules; wire submission and message notify events

Three new nightly auto-rules following the existing no_response_chase
pattern (grouped/capped, spec v1.2 Part 4/§3.0b/§3.8):
- reply_to_unanswered: Messenger, capped 5, oldest-unanswered-first
- profile_completion: single evolving task per person, reuses the same
  completion definition already shown on the profile page
- reconnect_dormant_contact: NRM, strong-but-dormant relationships
  (strengthScore, not strengthLabel — the dormancy override forces that
  to QUIET and would make this rule un-triggerable via the label)

BenchSubmissionService now fires stage_change plus a specific notify event
(interview_scheduled/offer_extended/placement_confirmed/submission_rejected)
on every genuine Submission status transition. MessengerService fires
message_received for every recipient except the sender, inside the same
transaction as the message write.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add activity module build notes; include pre-existing uncommitted docs

skills/activity-module-notes.md documents this session's decisions
(terminology translation, the reverted architecture conflict, what was
already built vs. new, the n8n-vs-direct-dispatch call, module survey
findings). docs/audit-report.md and the hermes-architecture-frozen-v1.md
addition were already present, uncommitted, in the working tree before
this session started — not authored this session, included as-is per the
user's explicit confirmation to commit the working tree together.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(extension): list the caller's private tracker and change a record's status

GET  /extension/v3/tracker (status filter, cursor paging, max 100)
PATCH /extension/v3/tracker/:id/status

Records saved from the extension were only readable one at a time, so the
web Job Tracker had no way to show them. Both routes are owner and
context scoped, read the existing tracked_requirements table, and need no
schema change. Statuses: SAVED, APPLYING, APPLIED, INTERVIEWING, OFFER,
CLOSED.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(auth): pass the seventh AuthService dependency in two specs

AuthService gained IdentityMergeService as a seventh constructor argument
and two specs still built it with six, so those suites failed to compile
and Core CI has been red on main. Test-only change.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(extension): use the Job Tracker screen's status names for tracker records

SAVED (Bookmarked), APPLYING, APPLIED, INTERVIEWING, NEGOTIATING, ACCEPTED
and the closed states WITHDREW, NOT_SELECTED, NO_RESPONSE, so the web
tracker maps one to one.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge origin/main into features (mechanical sync)

Brings `features` up to date with `main` (65 commits, incl. merged PRs #3-#8
and #16) so work that depends on main's tables can be reviewed against
`features`. No behaviour is added here; the only edits beyond the merge are
the fixes below that the combination itself required.

Conflicts resolved (all additive, both sides kept):
- prisma/schema.prisma: Task.isEvolving (features) + Integration Studio
  models (features) + Companies directory, billing, credits, resume
  collaboration, tracked requirements, extension captures (main).
- src/config/configuration.ts, env.validation.ts: dittofeed (features) +
  stripe/razorpay/profileCompleteness (main).
- src/health/health.controller.ts: DittofeedDispatchService and HermesClient
  both injected.
- src/bench/submission.service.ts: getEventsForActivityEmbed (features) kept
  alongside main's reformatted updateSubmissionStatus.
- src/bench/bench.module.ts: main's exports.

Fixes required by the merge:
- Dittofeed webhook controller no longer imports @CsrfExempt: main removed
  the CSRF layer (e74b2db, bearer-token auth), so the decorator file no
  longer exists.
- health.controller.spec passes the new HermesClient argument.
- Two auth specs pass the seventh AuthService argument (identical to the
  fix in PR #17/#18; main's CI is red without it).

Verification: prisma validate + generate clean, tsc --noEmit clean,
nest build clean, jest 79 suites / 488 tests pass.
Not run: migrations against a database. features' pre-Sep-19 migrations sort
before main's later ones; apply with `prisma migrate deploy` on a scratch DB
before promoting.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(job-tracker): Core job tracker API for consultant, bench sales and recruiter

The web app had no real tracker backend: the extension built its own
(tracked_requirements) because Core had none. This adds the Core module the
extension can later delegate to, with one API and three role views.

- Personal records (consultant · bench_sales · recruiter): list / summary /
  create / get / update / soft-delete over tracked_requirements, with
  server-side filter, search, sort and paging. Same sha256(url) dedupe as the
  extension; jobs it saved appear in the list.
- Bench sales "My Submissions": list / summary / detail / checklist over the
  existing submissions, plus the four stat-card flags (follow-ups due,
  awaiting reply, interviews this week, offers pending). One rule feeds both
  the database filter and the per-row tag; a spec proves they agree.
  Status changes stay on PATCH /bench/submissions/:id/status.
- Recruiter "Job Tracker" (read-only): the recruiter's jobs with real
  per-status submission counts, and per-job submissions limited to candidate
  name, stage and dates (no vendor contact, notes, commission, checklist,
  rate or margin).
- Submission.checklist (JSONB, migration 20260920000000): the six readiness
  checks (resume, rate, visa, availability, RTR, links). Ticking one does not
  touch updatedAt, so it never resets the awaiting-reply clock.
- Lifecycles frozen: personal record statuses as the extension uses them;
  submissions shown as the roadmap lifecycle, with SCREENING displayed as
  Submitted + a Screening sub-stage. Employer is denied on every route.
- docs/job-tracker/JOB-TRACKER-API.md is the contract.

Tests: 68 new (84 suites / 556 tests total pass); tsc and prisma validate
clean. Not run: the migration and the queries against a real database.

Stacked on chore/sync-main-into-features (#19): it needs main's
tracked_requirements tables, which `features` does not have.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(job-tracker): stage chips and stat cards whose numbers equal their lists

- stage=SUBMITTED now includes SCREENING (it is displayed as a sub-stage of
  Submitted), and the summary returns byStage (lifecycle counts) next to
  byStatus, so a chip's count equals the rows you get on click.
- Recruiter job list gains a flag filter (awaitingReview, interviewsThisWeek,
  offersPending, noSubmissions) and the recruiter summary now counts JOBS with
  the same conditions, instead of counting submissions.

Tests: 74 in src/job-tracker pass; tsc clean.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge origin/feat/extension-tracker-list (PR #18) as written, before rebuilding it on Core

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

refactor(extension): serve the extension tracker from the Core Job Tracker

The extension no longer keeps its own tracker logic. GET /extension/v3/tracker
and PATCH /extension/v3/tracker/:id/status keep the workspace check
(assertContext) and delegate to TrackerRecordsService, the same service the web
tracker uses, so ownership, soft delete, ordering and the status vocabulary live
in one place.

- TrackerRecordsService: listCursor (cursor paging, optional context scope),
  setStatus (single scoped write), skills in the record view
- parseRecordStatus in job-tracker.constants; TRACKER_STATUSES is now an alias
  of RECORD_STATUSES, with a test that fails if they drift
- Extension wire format and PR #18's tests are unchanged
- Contract spec + docs section "Chrome extension - one tracker, not two"
